name: How long does a garage-to-living-space conversion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage-to-living-space conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion project generally spans from 2 to 6 months, though this can vary. Key stages include initial design and planning (2-4 weeks), permit acquisition (4-8 weeks, depending on city), and construction (6-12 weeks). Delays can occur due to unforeseen structural issues, material availability, or permit revisions. Professional project management helps streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical garage conversion project takes 2 to 6 months, covering design, permit acquisition, and construction phases.
